identificationModule.briefTitle: Combination Chemotherapy +/- Radiation in High Risk Hodgkin's Disease
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Trial of Stanford VI ± Radiation Therapy in Locally Extensive and Advanced Stage Hodgkin's Disease With 3+ Risk Factors: the G6 Study

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Patients with 3 or more adverse prognostic factors have a higher relapse rate. Significant anti-tumor activity in Hodgkin's lymphoma has been reported with two new drugs:gemcitabine and vinorelbine. The introduction of these new agents with their different mechanisms of action into the Stanford V regimen may increase effectiveness while maintaining a favorable toxicity profile with respect to fertility and a low risk of secondary leukemia. On this basis, we propose a new regimen, Stanford VI, for patients with bulky and advanced HD with 3 or more risk factors.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
Patients will receive chemotherapy weekly for 19 weeks, alone or followed by irradiation as indicated per protocol guidelines.

* Doxorubicin 25 mg/m2 IV w 1,3,5,7,9,11
* Vinblastine 6 mg/m2 IV w 1,3,5,7,9,11
* Cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 IV w 1, 5, 9
* Etoposide2 60 mg/mg2 x 2 IV w 3, 7,11
* Vincristine1 1.4 mg/m2 IV w 2,4,6,8,10,12 (cap @ 2mg)
* Bleomycin 5 u/m2 IV w 2,4,6,8,10,12
* Gemcitabine 1250 mg/m2 IV w 13,15,17,19
* Vinorelbine 25 mg/m2 IV w 13,15,17,19
* Prednisone 40 mg/m2 PO qod w 1-10, taper

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Untreated, locally extensive or advanced stage classical Hodgkin's disease
* 3 or more adverse risk factors
* Age \> 18 years and \< 70 years.
* No prior invasive malignancies for \> 5 years except curatively-treated basal cell or squamous cell carcinoma of the skin or carcinoma in situ of the cervix.
* ECOG performance status 0 to 2
* WBC \> 4000/µL
* Platelets \> 100,000/µL
* Creatinine \< 2.0mg/dL
* Bilirubin \< 5.0mg/dL

Exclusion Criteria:

* HIV-positive
* Pregnant or currently breast feeding women
* Lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin's disease
